assumptions: Lifecycle selection is navigation only; it never changes the editable process or Preview target.
Central-draft synchronization is intentionally unavailable until divergence signaling is implemented.
expected_behavior: Exactly one of Prototype or Automation is WORKING; the other is FROZEN.
Publication is an immutable PUBLISHED snapshot and never the mutable process.
Show in Preview explicitly chooses a supported Lifecycle snapshot.
Publication exposes checkpoint, release validation, publish, and delete; it never overwrites DEV from Root.
Builder preserves the complete UI 042 control plane.
Project selection is projected atomically from Yjs state.
Choose Project uses bounded live project data with search and archived filtering.
New projects can be based on scenario or skill templates.
Every skill-backed Builder operation declares the active Builder surface so nested preview actions remain isolated.
current_scenario identifies the Builder surface; scenario_id and project_id remain reserved for the selected project.
user_summary.preview: Preview headings use proto:, active:, or public: prefixes.
user_summary.risks: Returning to Prototype runs a guarded LLM adaptation and is asynchronous.
